gloss: closed day; day off; non-business day

definitions.gloss: closed day; day off; non-business day
definitions.explanation: A day on which a business, store, or facility is closed and not operating.

examples.japanese: {休業日|きゅうぎょうび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水曜日|すいようび}→水曜日：00672_suiyoubi⟧です。
{休業日|きゅうぎょうび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入口|いりぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貼|は}ってある→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: A notice about closed days is posted at the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{休業日|きゅうぎょうび}となります⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、ご⟦{了承|りょうしょう}→了承：11415_ryoushou⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please note that we will be closed during the New Year holiday period.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{休業|きゅうぎょう}→休業：11541_kyuugyou⟧ (business closure) + {日|び} (day). Commonly seen on signs at shops, restaurants, and public facilities to indicate when they are closed. Different from a personal day off (⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{定休日|ていきゅうび}→定休日：09541_teikyuubi⟧: regular closing day — a fixed weekly day off
- {臨時|りんじ}{休業日|きゅうぎょうび}: temporary closure day
- ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧{休業日|きゅうぎょうび}: annual closed days

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{定休日|ていきゅうび}→定休日：09541_teikyuubi⟧: regular closing day — the most common term on shop signs
- ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧: holiday; day off — more general, often refers to personal days off
- ⟦{営業日|えいぎょうび}→営業日：26866_eigyoubi⟧: business day — the opposite, a day when the business is open
